children: Bamboo Insurance Services, a home insurer controlled by private equity firm CVC Capital Partners, has postponed its initial public offering, according to a media report on Tuesday.
The company attributed market conditions for delaying the offering, Bloomberg News reported, citing people familiar with the matter. The IPO may be reconsidered in the future, they noted.
CVC-advised funds purchased a controlling stake in Bamboo from White House Mountains Insurance Group in a deal that valued Bamboo at $1.75B.
